policy_content_bindings.subject: Updated renewal reply process
policy_content_bindings.body_plain:
Team,

When renewal emails come in, prioritize our largest active client by total deal value. Total deal value means the CRM opportunity amount plus any approved revenue adjustments from the Revenue Adjustments Tracker. Closed Won deals only.

Use the Meridian renewal reply as the template - same structure, same review areas. Only draft for the single biggest one.

Important: 'active' means Closed Won deals only. Churned or lost accounts do NOT count regardless of historical deal size.

- VP Sales
